comments.body: @pcbeingused333 I've receiving a lot of PRs from you. Can you please explain your usage before I continue to accept the PRs. Thank you.

Thanks for asking. I use an AI coding assistant (Claude Code) to find bugs in provider integrations, and the commits carry a Co-Authored-By line for it. For each PR I reproduce the problem first, add regression tests, and run the repo test suite. I opened several PRs in a row because the Mistral, Together, MiniMax and Groq providers shared the same gap, and I can fold them into one PR or hold the rest while you review this one, whichever you prefer.
